slides.title: Surface Laptop Ultra with Local AI
slides.subtitle: For Embargoed Creative Work

slides.title: Creative Process
slides.takeaway: Like a chef’s kitchen, not a restaurant
slides.notes: Narrative design is like cooking. Playtest sessions are ingredients, feedback digests are recipes, and dialogue drafts are dishes. Local AI provides a dedicated kitchen space for embargoed work.

slides.title: Workflows
slides.notes: Microsoft 365 Copilot handles public tasks, while local AI on Surface handles embargoed creative material. This hybrid approach ensures secure workflows without replacing existing tools.

slides.title: Current Workflow
slides.notes: Each session review takes about 40 minutes to turn into a digest. Local AI can reduce this time significantly, especially for repetitive tasks like summarizing and drafting.

slides.title: Device Capacity

data.caption: Surface Laptop Ultra with NVIDIA RTX Spark

slides.notes: The Surface Laptop Ultra has 128 GB memory and 20 CPU cores. It supports 28 open models locally, ensuring performance for creative tasks without relying on cloud resources.

slides.title: Offline vs Online

data.verdict: Ideal for offsite playtests and conventions.

slides.notes: Offline use is validated in the pilot. Local AI works without internet, making it perfect for offsite playtest venues and conventions where connectivity is unreliable.

slides.title: Use Cases
slides.notes: This matrix shows how local AI fits into the workflow. Secure and offline work is best handled by local AI, while public tasks use Copilot.

slides.title: Time Savings Estimate
slides.notes: Illustrative estimate: if local AI saves 15 minutes per digest, that's 2,475 hours/year. This will be validated during the pilot.

slides.title: Pilot Plan
slides.notes: The pilot involves 6 users over 2 weeks. It will measure digest time, draft quality, and user experience to validate the benefits of local AI.

slides.title: Pilot Ask

data.sub: On Surface Laptop Ultra with local AI

slides.notes: We ask for approval to run a 2-week pilot with 6 users. This will validate time savings and usability for embargoed creative work.
